source.method: straight-line fit to the published characteristic curve over one log H window shared by all three channels, [-2.6, -0.7], on the sheet's own log H axis, which prints no unit, anchored to Kodak's lux-second axis at the sheet's printed ISO 400/27° through the ISO 5800 speed point (green and the slower of red and blue, each at minimum density plus 0.15), a shift of +0.40, which makes the window Kodak's [-2.2, -0.3]
source.publication: FilmoTec Datenblatt WOLFEN NC500 (no document code printed, PDF dated 2022-10-28)

name: Wolfen NC500
note: Dye gammas are this stock's own, read off its maker's published characteristic curve. Nothing here is measured from a roll. Its own emulsion. The maker's sheet calls it a cinema negative film offered in 35 mm for C-41, names InovisCoat GmbH as coater in its footer, and ties it to no other stock.
